topic: find the wifi password on a Windows laptop already connected
core_question: How do I see the wifi password for a network my Windows laptop is already connected to? (secondary: How do you get rid of a musty/mildew smell coming from a front-load washing machine?)
answer_summary: Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks (or Control Panel's Network Sharing Center), open the network's Wireless Properties, Security tab, and check 'Show characters'.; after the topic shift: Run an empty cycle on the hottest setting with a washing-machine cleaner tablet or a cup of white vinegar (and baking soda), wipe out the rubber door gasket and detergent drawer where mold collects, and leave the door ajar between washes to let it air dry.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; using casual slang
